reasons: Status is correct: p0077 caps only TrueLink's liability (12 months' compensation 'paid') and leaves Client uncapped with no confidentiality/data/indemnity/fraud/IP carve-outs and no consequential-damages exclusion — squarely the playbook walk-away scenario, so a 'deviation' finding with an actionable redline is appropriate.

Redline reaches the preferred position: mutual ('either party's') aggregate cap at the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and USD 1,000,000, mutual indirect/consequential exclusion, an Excluded Claims definition covering confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement, plus the 'payment obligations are not damages' protection.

The failed minimal-edit check (0.809 changed ratio) is acceptable here: converting a one-sided, narrow cap into a mutual capped-with-carve-outs clause necessarily rewrites the single sentence, and the drafter kept the original all-caps style, the 'hosting and support services' fee basis and the existing gross negligence/wilful misconduct exception rather than replacing the section.
Comment is accurate, in-tone and prefixed, correctly states the position and offers the 12-months-fees fallback.

Minor points to flag in negotiation (not disqualifying): the edit broadens the cap's scope from 'Sections 3, 4, 7 and 11' to the whole Agreement, which extends cap protection to TrueLink matters previously uncapped (mitigated by the USD 1,000,000 floor and the new carve-outs), and 'indemnification obligations under this Section 12' should be confirmed to sit in Section 12 and to capture all indemnities, not only that section's.
